students(student_id INTEGER, name TEXT, grade_level INTEGER, enrol_date TEXT, scholarship_code TEXT) -- 800 rows
courses(course_id INTEGER, title TEXT, dept_code TEXT, credits INTEGER) -- 300 rows
enrollments(enrollment_id INTEGER, student_id INTEGER, course_id INTEGER, term TEXT, score REAL, result_code TEXT) -- 3000 rows
result_codes(code TEXT, meaning TEXT) -- 5 rows

steps.name: run_sql

arguments.query: SELECT DISTINCT dept_code FROM courses

steps.output:
dept_code
DEP_HUM
DEP_SCI

steps.name: run_sql

arguments.query: SELECT c.title FROM enrollments e JOIN courses c ON c.course_id = e.course_id WHERE c.dept_code = 'DEP_HUM' AND e.term = '2023-Fall' AND e.score IS NOT NULL GROUP BY c.course_id ORDER BY AVG(e.score) DESC LIMIT 1

steps.output:
title
Practical Astronomy
